    DecisionFigure - Record Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    A decision-tree figure as marks on a page: rectangles, circles, polygons, polylines and text, each at a place in the figure's own units, each with its paint and a role naming what it stands for.
    DecisionFigure(double, double, String, List) - Constructor for record class network.ike.docs.koncept.DecisionFigure
    Creates an instance of a DecisionFigure record class.
    DecisionFigure.Circle - Record Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    A circle about its centre.
    DecisionFigure.Mark - Interface in network.ike.docs.koncept
    One mark of the figure.
    DecisionFigure.Polygon - Record Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    A closed polygon through its points, as x0, y0, x1, y1, ….
    DecisionFigure.Polyline - Record Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    An open polyline through its points, as x0, y0, x1, y1, …, round-capped and round-joined.
    DecisionFigure.Rect - Record Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    An axis-aligned rectangle from its top-left corner.
    DecisionFigure.Stroke - Record Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    How a mark's outline is drawn; null for no outline.
    DecisionFigure.Text - Record Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    A run of text whose top-left corner is at (x, top): the writers set the baseline from the size, so a label sits where the builder put its box.
    DecisionFigureSvg - Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    A DecisionFigure as one self-contained SVG document: a viewBox the figure's size, every mark an element whose class is the mark's role, text in the sans face the width estimate is of.
    DecisionFigureText - Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    What a figure builder knows about text without a font engine: an estimate of a run's width from the average widths of a Helvetica-like sans face, in em per character, so the geometry a layout computes from label widths is the same on every machine and in every medium, and the figure's palette and number formats, which the live JavaFX surface shares.
    DecisionFigureText.Unit - Enum Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    What a swept quantity is: a share of those at a node, money, or anything else with a unit of its own.
    DecisionFigureTornado - Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    A tornado diagram of a decision tree's one-way sensitivity as a DecisionFigure, drawn as the live TornadoChart draws it: one bar per swept measure, longest first, on one axis.
    DecisionFigureTornado.Bar - Record Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    One measure's bar.
    DecisionFigureTornado.Choice - Enum Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    What the root chose along a stretch of a bar, against what it chose at the base.
    DecisionFigureTornado.Money - Interface in network.ike.docs.koncept
    How an amount on the axis is printed.
    DecisionFigureTornado.Segment - Record Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    A stretch of a bar between two cuts, by where each cut falls on the axis.
    DecisionFigureTornado.Tick - Record Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    A flip, by where it falls on the axis; threshold is the measure's value there, printed with its unit, for a root flip.
    DecisionFigureTornado.Tornado - Record Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    The sweep as the tornado reads it.
    DecisionFigureTypst - Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    A DecisionFigure as Typst code: one box the figure's size, in points, and inside it every mark placed at its coordinates, so the print pipeline draws the figure natively, with the document's own text, and never through an embedded image.
